subject: Xylophone and two mallets
observations: The malformed long paddle-like support beneath the right side is removed. Two short block feet now support the wooden base and read as coherent instrument supports.

Two distinct mallets are visible: a purple round head with its shaft partly occluded behind the left bars, and a yellow round head with a separate short rounded handle above the right side. Neither mallet continues into an implausible leg below the instrument.

Five broad red, yellow, green, cyan and dark-blue bars, purple mallet head and warm wooden base provide meaningful contrasting colours. Repeated fasteners and yellow parts add visual repetition without relying on shading for palette credit.
The xylophone, bar sequence, rounded mallet heads and uncluttered composition are recognizable and child-friendly. No eyes, mouths or faces appear on any object.
